brief_title: Study of Pembrolizumab (MK-3475) as Post-Nephrectomy Adjuvant Therapy for Renal Cell Carcinoma (MK-3475-564/KEYNOTE-564)
official_title: A Phase 3, Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Clinical Trial of Pembrolizumab as Adjuvant Therapy for Renal Cell Carcinoma (KEYNOTE-564)

intervention.name: Pembrolizumab
intervention.description: 200 mg IV every 3 weeks for up to 17 cycles (~1 year)

intervention.name: Placebo
intervention.description: Normal saline IV every 3 weeks for up to 17 cycles (~1 year)

eligibility.criteria_summary: Clear-cell RCC post-nephrectomy with intermediate-high or high risk of recurrence (pT2 Grade 4 or sarcomatoid, pT3/4, N+) or M1 NED after metastasectomy; ECOG PS 0-1

stratification_factors: Metastasis status at study entry (M0 vs M1 NED)
Geographic region within M0 (US vs ex-US)

publications.citation: Choueiri TK et al. N Engl J Med 2024;390:1322-1334
publications.title: Overall Survival with Adjuvant Pembrolizumab in Renal-Cell Carcinoma
